verdicts.claim: From 1992 to 2018... Republicans gained vote share between the general election and the runoff in seven of eight statewide general-election runoffs (Inside Elections).

Part of the gain is mechanical, because third-party votes drop out; in 2018 the Democrat (Miller) also 'increased her vote share'.
